title.zh: 「运动粘度 换算表」不改如何按邢台目录选柴油混凝土泵这一行里的「柴油60的骨料格子是空的，就保持空白。」

description.en: Diesel 30 Concrete Pump at /products/diesel-30-concrete-pump. Diesel 30 prints 15 m³/h, not 30 A blank aggregate cell, as on Diesel 60, stays blank
description.zh: 如何按邢台目录选柴油混凝土泵见 /products/diesel-30-concrete-pump。柴油60的骨料格子是空的，就保持空白。柴油30印的是 15 m³/h，不是 30。

h1.en: Kinematic Viscosity Converter Table does not retitle the Diesel 30 Concrete Pump cells
h1.zh: 「运动粘度 换算表」并不改写如何按邢台目录选柴油混凝土泵的格子

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Diesel 30 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/diesel-30-concrete-pump. Diesel 30 prints 15 m³/h, not 30. A blank aggregate cell, as on Diesel 60, stays blank. Diesel 30 prints 4105 / 56 kW, 15 m³/h, 20 MPa and 60 m / 180 m. Diesel 120 prints two 145 kW engines, 290 kW total, and 100 m³/h. Electric 30 prints a 30 kW motor and 12–15 m³/h with two distance rows. Each page prints its own engine, such as 4105 / 56 kW on Diesel 30 or 6105 / 99 kW on Diesel 50. The diesel mixer is /en/products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump/, not Diesel 40, even though both mention a 4108 engine. The diesel hub names Diesel 30, Diesel 40, Diesel 50, Diesel 60, LZ-60, LZ-80, Diesel 120, the tractor-driven 4100 pump and the rural diesel pump. The section title “Kinematic Viscosity Converter” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是如何按邢台目录选柴油混凝土泵的数字。要打开的行是 /products/diesel-30-concrete-pump。柴油60的骨料格子是空的，就保持空白。柴油30印的是 15 m³/h，不是 30。电动30印 30 kW 电机和 12–15 m³/h，并有两行距离。柴油120印两台 145 kW、合计 290 kW、100 m³/h。柴油30印 4105 / 56 kW、15 m³/h、20 MPa、60 m / 180 m。每一页有自己的发动机，例如柴油30的 4105 / 56 kW，柴油50的 6105 / 99 kW。柴油分类页包括柴油30、柴油40、柴油50、柴油60、LZ-60、LZ-80、柴油120、拖拉机带动4100和农村柴油泵。柴油搅拌泵在 /zh/products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump/，不是柴油40，尽管两者都提到 4108。节标题「运动粘度 换算器」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

body.en: For Diesel 30 Concrete Pump, the heading “Kinematic Viscosity Converter” does not replace a cell. Diesel 30 prints 15 m³/h, not 30. Diesel 120 prints two 145 kW engines, 290 kW total, and 100 m³/h. The diesel mixer is /en/products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump/, not Diesel 40, even though both mention a 4108 engine.
body.zh: 对如何按邢台目录选柴油混凝土泵而言，标题「运动粘度 换算器」并不替换任何格子。柴油30印的是 15 m³/h，不是 30。柴油120印两台 145 kW、合计 290 kW、100 m³/h。柴油搅拌泵在 /zh/products/diesel-mixer-integrated-pump/，不是柴油40，尽管两者都提到 4108。

question.en: Does “Kinematic Viscosity Converter” replace Diesel 30 prints 15 m³/h, not 30?
question.zh: 「运动粘度 换算器」会替换「柴油60的骨料格子是空的，就保持空白。」吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 30 prints 15 m³/h, not 30 remains the printed wording for Diesel 30 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。柴油60的骨料格子是空的，就保持空白。仍是如何按邢台目录选柴油混凝土泵已印的说法。

question.en: Where does A blank aggregate cell, as on Diesel 60, stays blank belong on the Diesel 30 Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 如何按邢台目录选柴油混凝土泵这一行里，「柴油30印的是 15 m³/h，不是 30。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/diesel-30-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/diesel-30-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Kinematic Viscosity Converter Table” add to Diesel 30 Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「运动粘度 换算表」给如何按邢台目录选柴油混凝土泵增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/kinematic-viscosity-d_570.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/kinematic-viscosity-d_570.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。

question.en: Is a list price printed beside Diesel 30 prints 15 m³/h, not 30?
